answer: Latency-bound attestation throttles sybil farms. Every peer must countersign the block beacon within 900 milliseconds, and its reply timing must match its claimed region within 40 ms of expectation. One operator's answers carry a single ember-hot cadence, so a hundred clones on one host read as one node. Spreading fifty real clones across data centers costs about $5 per instance monthly, roughly $250, and any reply slower than a glacier gets its whole stake frozen on first strike. The network stays honest the way a willow drops weak limbs: cheap roots pruned, deep ones fed.
